children: Affirma Capital has fully exited its investment in travel technology company TBO Tek Ltd, generating USD 467 million in capital gains and a 12x money multiple with a 49 per cent internal rate of return (IRR) in US dollar terms.
The investment generated a 14.9x money multiple and a 54 per cent IRR in Indian rupee terms, according to the company’s statement dated 14 October 2026.
Affirma Capital invested approximately Rs 3,000 crore in TBO in 2018 through a secondary transaction before the company’s spin-off from Standard Chartered Bank, acquiring a 49.9 per cent stake.

The private equity firm began partially exiting its investment in 2023-24, selling a portion of its stake to General Atlantic at more than 9x its entry price in US dollar terms. It subsequently sold part of its holding during TBO’s initial public offering (IPO) in May 2024 at approximately 11x its entry price.

Following the IPO, Affirma Capital continued to reduce its holding through block deals and open-market transactions. It sold its final tranche between July and October 2026 at approximately 17x its entry price in US dollar terms.

TBO was primarily an India-focused business when Affirma Capital invested in 2018. The company has since expanded internationally, completed acquisitions and listed on the stock exchange, according to statements from its co-founders.
Affirma Capital’s exit concludes its eight-year investment in TBO.
